main.description: A snapshot of a superseded (op update) or removed (op delete, modAction only) version, in the same repo as its subject. Record key: {P}-{tid}, where P = fk(subject) for a forum and rkey(subject) otherwise. Never updated.

subject.description: The superseded version: a post, comment, forum, sequence or modAction record in this repo.

op.description: update, or delete (only when the subject is a modAction). An unknown value makes the revision invalid.

record.description: The verbatim prior value. Writers MUST include it. An object whose $type MUST be present and equal the subject's collection; its CID MUST equal subject.cid.

createdAt.description: Set once at creation by the writer's clock; never changed.
